title: Space manifest — space.yaml (v1)
description: No single §5 table enumerates space.yaml's fields (Open Q1). Derived from §4.2's layout comment ('manifest: space id, schema version, participants, gates config, notification routes') plus the A2.13 excerpt. Fields named in prose but absent from A2.13 (full `gates` sub-shape, notification routes) are typed permissively (open) pending a normative table.

schema.description: Literal value per A2.13's golden fixture — NOT `manifest/v1` (see phase deviations note: naming tension between this value and the sibling envelope/event/consumes URI convention, unresolved upstream).

space.description: P41 variant c: lowercase letters/digits, hyphen-separated, no underscores — this is what makes internal/space.CredentialEnvVar's `-`->`_` mapping injective (no two distinct ids can ever collide on one A2A_TOKEN_<ID> variable, e.g. `my-space` vs. `my_space`). EXCEPTION: `REPLACE_WITH_SPACE_ID` is carved into the pattern rather than the id shape being enforced everywhere, because it is the literal scaffolding sentinel `internal/cli/cmd_space.go`'s spaceIDSentinel byte-matches and replaces (`a2a space init`) — that file is outside this pattern's authoring scope, so renaming the sentinel to a conforming value was not an option here. This reintroduces exactly the one collision the pattern otherwise forecloses (`REPLACE_WITH_SPACE_ID` and the legal id `replace-with-space-id` both render to `A2A_TOKEN_REPLACE_WITH_SPACE_ID`), accepted because the template's placeholder is never itself a live, connected space id.

min_binary_version.description: D-013: stale binaries refuse to operate against a space above their known version.

gates.description: Gates config (G1-G5, §3.7) — full sub-shape not tabulated in §5 (Open Q1); typed permissively.

vendored.description: Read-only vendor mirrors (§4.4); item shape not tabulated in §5 (Open Q1) — typed permissively.

notification_routes.description: space-notify-2026-08 P1 §7: bot-relay notification routes. additionalProperties:false on the route object — an unknown key is a typo, and a typo in a notification route is silence. `chat` is a STRING, not an integer: Telegram supergroup ids exceed the safe integer range of several YAML/JSON readers.
